commit.message: Keep engine verification and AMD setup tests isolated
Fix shared CPU dependencies in SYCL and native-disabled builds

GLM: add opt-in B550 decode optimizations and Q22 down overlays

Add experimental kernel/transfer fusion, stable tier lookup uploads and
partial CPU expert deferral. Support validated down-only Q22 sidecars on
assembled Q23 models while retaining source and payload validation.
Fix the mailbox route mask for 64-route batches and add norm/Q8 parity
and overlay rejection tests.

Record DDR4-2133 B550 results and an explicit experimental config:
33.57/33.61 decode tok/s, 26/30 functional coding passes versus 29/30
for Q23. Reject the 35.07 tok/s variant after its coding gate fails.
Defaults remain unchanged; no model weights are committed.

Validation: HIP and CUDA builds; four HIP tests; seven assembly tests;
opt-in heads kernel test; 256-token byte-identical logits comparison.
Document scoped pre-push findings and the existing outbound history.

B550 lever sweep and step-1 measurements; determinism bisection

From the B550 measurement session (reviewed here): the 8-worker run of the
lever sweep, the step-1 runs (15 GB budget: affinity 0.06 17.07 tok/s,
affinity 0.08 18.19, MTP1 11.14, affinity 0.08 + MTP1 17.31 against a
base of 11.2-12.5) with manifests, results and token streams, and the
records in tools/sim/data/measured_b550_levers.json.

From this session: docs/fixtures/glm_b550_levers_20261009/determinism shows
the batched FP16 prefill expert path is the only source of cross-process
nondeterminism (mmq prefill makes BASE and MTP1 bit-identical), and the
affinity re-measured with mmq prefill (0.06: 16.49, 0.08: 18.02 tok/s,
base 10.97). step1/SUMMARY.md carries a correction note: its MTP1 "bug"
is the prefill nondeterminism.

tools/sim: fix the expert-deferral model

Deferral charged the shared and resident GPU experts, which already overlap
the CPU pass, as serial GPU time, so deferral looked slower than no deferral.
A deferred share f of the CPU work now overlaps the next layer's serial GPU
chain: layer = max((1 - f) cpu, overlapped GPU) + max(serial GPU, f cpu).
B550 affinity 0.08: deferral 0.3 now predicts 21.5 tok/s against 18.7
without it (previously 18.5).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

tools/sim: B550 step-1 calibration; per-preset MTP tier reserve

- The MTP tier-fill reserve is an explicit per-preset runtime_vram value
  applied only with MTP (tr16 1,280 MiB, B550 244 MiB measured in step 1);
  the owned-reserve option no longer subtracts from every preset's misc,
  which had driven the B550 entry negative and overstated its tier by 700 MiB.
- params_b550: affinity response 0.12 and MTP draft step 3.0 ms, fitted on
  the 31 B550 lever runs incl. step 1 (mean error 4.1 % -> 2.8 %).
  Step 1 now predicts within 5 % (affinity 0.08: 18.66 vs 18.19 tok/s).

Calibrate B550 GLM simulator from 512-token lever checkpoint

tools/sim: calibrate tr16 decode on the interleaved lever matrix

Measured on tr16 2026-10-09 (build-levers, q23 MTP2 split verify, adaptive
tier, 512 fixed tokens, base between every lever, 12 base runs 16.2-19.9
tok/s under other jobs):
- prime512 acceptance profile: p1 0.903, p2 0.818, p3 0.793 from the rounds
  at depth 1-3; MTP depth ratios now match within 1-2 %.
- tr16 decode-time VRAM (runtime_vram from GPU_LIVE): prefill scratch 32 MiB,
  staging/prefetch freed, 1,280 MiB MTP tier-fill reserve; plans 3,813 MiB vs
  the measured 3,814 MiB tier. tier_owned_reserve models
  STRATA_GLM_TIER_OWNED_RESERVE=1 (v5 within 5 %).
- resident-expert cost 5 us per expert and 60 us fixed GPU work per layer,
  fitted to the affinity gains (+16 % / +20 % measured, +12 % / +19 % now).
- 8 lever records; q22 and gate skip did not help in practice and stay
  unfitted.
50 records validate; mean fit error 5.0 %.

GLM: calibrate B550 decoding and add opt-in cache probes

Add measured B550 simulator calibration, routing replay safeguards,
HIP canonical-rounding validation, and guarded speed/quality runners.
Prototype unbiased cache learning and state-restored cache probes behind
disabled-by-default flags; retain serving defaults and model weights.

Record fixed-affinity .06 tuning, experimental 8K prefill profiles, raw
measurements, quality failures, memory guards and reproduction steps.
The best repeated document result is 16.5 decode / 250.2 prefill tok/s;
the 18-20 decode target remains unmet and profiles stay experimental.

Validation: HIP/CUDA builds, probe state/next-logit parity, and staged-tree
Python tests (90 pass, 1 trace test skipped). Preserve concurrent TR16
simulator work outside this commit.

GLM quality gate: tighten tolerances

The evaluation is bit-for-bit repeatable in canonical mode (three runs gave
the same KL, nll and differing-logit count), so the limits now only absorb
intended rounding changes: KL baseline x 1.002 + 0.0002, top-1 baseline -
0.001, perplexity baseline x 1.002. They catch route affinity 0.05 (KL 0.143),
which the old limits let through. The runner prints full-precision metrics
and whether a run is bit-identical to the baseline.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

GLM: integrate B550 ROCm deployment and exact-cache experiments

Add ROCm/native expert integration, REAP assembly and guarded B550 launch
profiles, plus an opt-in exact CPU cache with direct reads and bounded
residency. Preserve benchmark, long-context quality, cache replay and RAM
bandwidth evidence with reproduction instructions and measured limitations.

Make the LAN web demo require authentication, respect GLM's greedy-only
sampling capability, and display live PP/TG rates from engine prefill timing
and rolling decode telemetry.

Validation: B550 HIP build, within-process bitwise cache parity including
forced eviction, live authenticated chat and PP/TG telemetry; GLM/monitor
regressions, cache replay and memory guard tests, CPU exact-cache checks,
JavaScript syntax and whitespace checks. Cache throughput remains experimental;
no 10 tok/s improvement is claimed for Q3_K_M.

GLM-5.3-Flash regression tests: kernels, short-context model runs, quality gate

ctest labels:
- glm: the existing GLM kernel and pool tests plus unit tests for the runner.
- glm_model (cmake -DSTRATA_GLM_MODEL_TESTS=ON): a 48-token prompt decoded for
  16 greedy tokens against golden ids, with the replay, verify and
  decode-graph self-checks, MTP2 split verify and an adaptive GPU tier, and
  the three model-based parity binaries (~3 min).
- glm_quality: 16 held-out sequences teacher-forced against the BF16 logits;
  fails on KL, top-1 or perplexity regression (~9 min after weight load).

Model tests skip when the files are missing and share one resource lock.
The baseline (KL 0.1367, top-1 87.68 %, ppl 4.825) matches the documented
q23 numbers. --check-prefill stays out: batched GPU prefill differs from
sequential execution in the KDA state beyond its 2 % limit, before and after
the merge. docs/GLM_TESTS.md describes running and re-recording.
